OtherAbstract.AbstractText: 靶向治疗和免疫治疗已成为非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）精准治疗的核心支柱，而分子病理检测是精准治疗的前提，其内涵随着临床新药的不断上市而持续增加。《非小细胞肺癌分子病理检测临床实践指南（2026更新版）》沿用2024版框架，以循证医学为核心支撑，严格遵循“临床需求导向-证据分级评估-本土数据融合”的更新原则，增加了MET扩增、HER2突变及KRAS突变作为必检基因，新增HER2扩增及过表达、MTAP缺失、SMARCA4缺失为扩展检测变异，以期为全面准确的NSCLC分子病理检测提供指导。.

Journal.Title: The Journal of thoracic and cardiovascular surgery

Article.ArticleTitle: 2026 Revised recommendations of the American Association for Thoracic Surgery (AATS) 2023 Expert Consensus Document: Staging and multidisciplinary management of patients with early-stage non-small cell lung cancer.

Abstract.AbstractText: Diagnosis, staging, and treatment of early-stage lung cancer remains an important area of thoracic surgical oncology. The previous American Association for Thoracic Surgery Expert Consensus Document, published in 2023, reflected critical recommendations for the workup and management of this disease, including the adoption of chemoimmunotherapy as standard of care for patients with locally advanced disease without targetable mutations. Since that publication, there have been additional publications that provide further insight into the management of these patients. This revised document seeks to refine best practice standards in regard to staging and diagnosis, neoadjuvant treatment, surgical management, and postoperative therapy of these patients based on the currently available data. Key modifications made to the previous version reflect additional randomized trials supporting the efficacy of preoperative or perioperative chemoimmunotherapy, adjuvant targeted therapy for eligible patients, and evolving practice standards regarding adjuvant immunotherapy for previously untreated patients. In addition, the current document continues to support the critical need for accurate diagnosis and staging of patients with nonmetastatic disease, including an emphasis on molecular diagnostics, as well as multidisciplinary evaluation of patients who are eligible for multi-modality treatment.

Journal.Title: Zhonghua zhong liu za zhi [Chinese journal of oncology]

Article.ArticleTitle: [Oncology Society of Chinese Medical Association guideline for clinical diagnosis and treatment of lung cancer (2026 edition)].

Abstract.AbstractText: To further standardize the prevention and management of lung cancer in China, improve the level of diagnosis and treatment, enhance patient prognosis, and provide evidence-based professional recommendations for clinical practitioners at all levels, the Oncology Society of Chinese Medical Association organized experts from respiratory medicine, medical oncology, thoracic surgery, radiation oncology, radiology, and pathology to develop the "Oncology Society of Chinese Medical Association guideline for clinical diagnosis and treatment of lung cancer (2026 edition)" through a consensus conference. Compared with the 2025 edition, the 2026 edition incorporates updates and refinements in several aspects. In the lung cancer screening section, quality control requirements for low-dose computed tomography screening have been further detailed, and the introduction and scope of application of opportunistic screening and artificial intelligence technologies in lung cancer screening have been added. In the pathology section, on the basis of the latest clinical research findings and newly approved indications by the National Medical Products Administration (NMPA), the recommendations for molecular pathological testing have been supplemented, with several new gene testing-related recommendations added. In the treatment section, perioperative neoadjuvant and adjuvant treatment regimens for non-small cell lung cancer have been updated according to newly approved drugs and indications; additional options for consolidation immunotherapy after concurrent or sequential chemoradiotherapy for unresectable stage Ⅲ non-small cell lung cancer have been incorporated; and first-line and subsequent-line treatment strategies for patients with advanced epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)-mutations have been further refined. In addition, treatment recommendations for patients with non-small cell lung cancer harboring molecular subtypes such as anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK) fusion, KRAS G12C mutation, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER-2) mutations, and MET amplification have also been updated based on the approval of novel agents. This guideline adheres to NMPA-approved indications as the core principle, is grounded in drugs practically available in China and integrates recommendations from international guidelines as well as the current status of clinical practice in China. It synthesizes the latest evidence-based medical advances in recent years covering lung cancer screening, diagnosis, pathology, genetic testing, immunologic and molecular biomarker testing, treatment modalities, and follow-up, with the aim of providing reasonable and practical recommendations for clinicians at all levels, as well as professionals in radiology, laboratory medicine, and related disciplines.

OtherAbstract.AbstractText: 为进一步规范中国肺癌的防治措施、提高肺癌的诊疗水平、改善患者的预后、为各级临床医务人员提供专业的循证医学建议，中华医学会肿瘤学分会组织呼吸内科、肿瘤内科、胸外科、放疗科、影像科和病理科专家，经过共识会议制订了《中华医学会肿瘤学分会肺癌临床诊疗指南（2026版）》。与2025版指南相比，2026版指南在多个方面进行了更新和完善。肺癌筛查部分进一步细化了低剂量螺旋CT筛查的质量控制要求，并增加了机会性筛查及人工智能技术在肺癌筛查中的应用介绍和适用范围。病理诊断部分结合最新临床研究结果及中国国家药品监督管理局（NMPA）新批准适应证，对分子病理检测内容进行了补充，新增了多个基因检测相关建议。治疗部分根据新获批的药物和适应证，对围术期非小细胞肺癌的新辅助及辅助治疗方案进行了更新；对不可切除Ⅲ期非小细胞肺癌同步或序贯放化疗后的免疫巩固治疗选择进行了补充；对晚期表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）基因突变患者一线及后线治疗策略进行了完善。此外，针对间变性淋巴瘤激酶（ALK）融合、KRAS G12C突变、人表皮生长因子受体2（HER-2）基因突变及MET扩增等分子亚型的非小细胞肺癌患者，也根据新型药物获批情况更新了相应治疗推荐。本指南以NMPA批准适应证为核心原则，以中国实际可应用的药品为基础，结合国际指南推荐意见和中国临床实践现状，整合近年来肺癌筛查、诊断、病理、基因检测、免疫分子标志物检测和治疗手段以及随访等诊治方面的最新循证医学证据，旨在为各级临床医师、影像、检验等专业人员提供合理的推荐建议。.

Article.ArticleTitle: Therapy for Stage IV Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer With Driver Alterations: ASCO Living Guideline, Version 2026.3.2.

Abstract.AbstractText: [Box: see text]Living guidelines are developed for selected topic areas with rapidly evolving evidence that drives frequent change in recommended clinical practice. Living guidelines are updated on a regular schedule by a standing expert panel that systematically reviews the health literature on a continuous basis, as described in the ASCO Guidelines Methodology Manual. ASCO Living Guidelines follow the ASCO Conflict of Interest Policy Implementation for Clinical Practice Guidelines. Living Guidelines and updates are not intended to substitute for independent professional judgment of the treating clinician and do not account for individual variation among patients. See appendix for disclaimers and other important information (Appendix 1 and Appendix 2, online only). Updates are published regularly and can be found on the ASCO Publications website.
